name: MacroObras
portfolioRole: A medium operational platform showing how software connects planning, people, physical execution and evidence.
headline: A hybrid construction platform connecting the administrative plan to field routines, camera evidence and measurement progression.
challenge: Construction progress is fragmented between office planning, measurement sheets, collaborators, daily routines and proof captured in the field.
productResponse: MacroObras creates a continuous operational chain from project and measurement configuration to authorised routines, construction diaries, photographic confirmation and comparison of performed work against the imported measurement base.

actors.name: Administrative operator
actors.responsibility: Register projects, import measurements, define elements and allocate work.

actors.name: Authorised collaborator
actors.responsibility: Open assigned projects, perform routines and submit field evidence.

actors.name: Measurement process
actors.responsibility: Relate execution and evidence to expected quantities and progress.

actors.name: Local services
actors.responsibility: Provide collaborator access, archive, OKF scaffold and local model endpoint.

productLayers.name: Installer
productLayers.description: Prepares a single installation folder, Archive, OKF references, collaborator endpoint and local Llama configuration.

productLayers.name: Administrative station
productLayers.description: Projects, measurement imports, elements, materials, dependencies, collaborators, schedules and comparison.

productLayers.name: Field application
productLayers.description: Authorised project access, daily routines, expandable schedule cards and construction diary.

productLayers.name: Evidence
productLayers.description: Camera confirmation and proof records related to the service performed.

productLayers.name: Progress
productLayers.description: Field diary submission feeds the measurement progression and comparison process.

productLayers.name: Knowledge and local runtime
productLayers.description: OKF entities, Archive, collaborator server and local intelligence endpoint.

implemented: Modular Nim backend separated by configuration, admin, installer, OKF and collaborator services
Frontend divided into installer, administration and mobile field screens
Project, measurement, element and collaborator administration
Field routine, daily schedule and construction diary surfaces
OKF scaffold for the core construction entities
Playwright UI validation and technical report generation
evidence: Backend responsibilities were explicitly decoupled into specialised modules.
The frontend has distinct installer, administrative and mobile surfaces with shared UI infrastructure.
Sixteen UI routines were validated through Playwright in the documented cycle.
The OKF scaffold names the relations required to connect the administrative and physical operation.
roadmap: Deepen measurement import and comparison semantics
Consolidate collaborator authorisation and network access
Improve field evidence review and exception handling
Connect local intelligence to archive and operational knowledge
Package desktop and mobile deployment paths
